title: US fixed-income markets closed for Columbus Day while the equity tape trades a full session — the Monday of October 2027 expiration week
source:
NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 298,772 bytes) and re-parsed independently by this session out of the page's embedded Next.js payload, because the 2027 tab is hidden in the rendered DOM. The US 2027 card reads exactly 'Columbus Day' / 'Monday, October 11, 2027' with an EMPTY note paragraph (the JSON literal is `"children":""`) — the full-closure shape. Positive control two cards earlier in the same panel: 'U.S. Independence Day' / 'Monday, July 5, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, July 2, 2027', which proves the parser reads early-close notes when they exist. CORROBORATED BY THREE FURTHER PRIMARIES, all fetched direct this same session. (1) federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm ('K.8 - Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030', HTTP 200, 80,538 bytes, page's own 'Last Update: July 8, 2026') carries the row 'Columbus Day | October 12 | October 11 | October 9 | October 8 | October 14' for 2026-2030, so the 2027 column is October 11. (2) frbservices.org/about/holiday-schedules (HTTP 200, 93,983 bytes) carries the identical row. (3) OCC's 2027 expiration calendar (www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, HTTP 200, 33,471 bytes) marks 2027-10-11 as {"holiday":{"description":"

Bank holiday

"}} — a BANK holiday marker, structurally distinct from the 'Exchange/OCC holiday' marker it uses for genuine exchange closures (e.g. 2025-01-01), i.e. options markets are open. THE EQUITY TAPE IS OPEN: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,148 bytes, all 133 text cells extracted) states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028' and contains ZERO occurrences of 'Columbus', 'Indigenous', 'October 11' or 'October 12'. AND BY ARITHMETIC: Columbus Day is the second Monday of October and October 2027's second Monday is the 11th. Filed estimate on the same three counts as every SIFMA entry on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule (nor for a Fed holiday page — FED: is scoped to the FOMC calendar), this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA states its closes are recommendations that firms are not bound by. The DATE is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICALISED 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/sifma-bond-holiday-close-2027-10-11.md) from the single proposal that discovered it, proposals/sifma-bond-holiday-close-2027-10-11.from-opex-2027-10-15.json (filed 2026-09-06 during the opex-2027-10-15 adjacency sweep). Every source in that proposal was re-fetched and every statistic recomputed this session; the proposal's date claim reproduces exactly and its refusal to call the date an edge is upheld and strengthened. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED, AND IT IS A NULL. The proposal's one open question was whether this instance differs from the sibling sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-10-12 because it sits INSIDE October expiration week (opex-2027-10-15 is at D+4). Measured this session over the 33 Columbus Day sessions 1993-2025, split on whether the second Monday and third Friday of October share a week: the closure-day paired TLT-minus-SPY volume-ratio gap is -0.357 in overlap years against -0.247 in non-overlap ones (permutation P = 0.606), and in the modern 2014+ era the two medians are -0.141 and -0.140 (P = 1.000). LQD P = 0.529, IEF P = 0.306. THE ONE SUB-0.05 RESULT IN THE WHOLE BATTERY DISSOLVED UNDER A MATCHED CONTROL: TLT's volume ratio on the expiration Friday itself reads 0.924x in overlap years against 1.441x otherwise (unpaired P = 0.042), but paired against SPY's own ratio the same day it is -0.167 against -0.040 (P = 0.420 pooled, 0.312 modern) — the gap was the general level of an October expiration Friday, not the closure. AND THE COINCIDENCE IS NOT A 2027 PROPERTY: Columbus Day falls inside October expiration week in 19 of the 33 years 1993-2025, structurally, and 2026-10-12 is itself an overlap year — so the sibling's date is not a control for this one. NEW SOURCE FACT THE SIBLING DOES NOT HAVE: SIFMA's Japan 2027 panel carries 'Health and Sports Day' / 'Monday, October 11, 2027' with the note 'Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan', where the 2026 Japan card for the same holiday carries an empty note. The three-panel darkness reproduces (US and UK both 'Columbus Day'; Japan its own national holiday) but the Japan leg for 2027 is explicitly provisional and is labelled as such rather than carried as fact. ESTIMATE WIDENS CAUTION AND LICENSES NOTHING: a recommended fixed-income close is not a market-wide halt, symbols is empty, impact is low, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped 2026-09-08 for 'holiday|veterans|columbus|closure|half-day|early close|opex|expiration|witching': zero hits in both). HONEST LIMITS. (1) The execution guard a reader would actually want for 2027 is NOT settled here and deliberately is not stated as if it were: it is downstream of FT-sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-10-12-1/-2/-3, which score on 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 — 41 days after this file was written and 357 days before this event. (2) The overlap split is n=14 vs n=10 pooled and n=7 vs n=5 modern; these nulls are consistent with no effect, not proof of none. (3) CME futures hours on 2027-10-11 are NOT asserted — cmegroup.com has returned 403 to this runner across every sibling lane and was not re-attempted. (4) treasurydirect.gov was not fetched, so nothing is asserted about auction or settlement handling on the closed day. (5) The historical sample assumes SIFMA recommended a Columbus Day full closure back to 1993; the published panels cover 2026 and 2027 only and the archive was not followed. (6) The kind field: EventKind has no market-structure member, so 'rates' follows every sibling SIFMA entry.
